title: app --stats-out=<path> (equals form) is silently ignored — telemetry-off with exit 0, while the harness fails loud on the same argv
detail: The changed parser's own contract ("never a silent telemetry-off", W1/R2-W3 comments) is violated for the equals form: a user habitually writing `--stats-out=path` gets no stream, no diagnostic, exit 0 — the harness treats the identical argv as a loud error.
recommended_fix: In the app loop, reject any unrecognized token starting with "--" (usage, exit 2), or accept the `--stats-out=path` form explicitly; keep parity with the harness's loud failure.
